Task: Click the toggle switch when it is in 'Night Mode'.
Expected Result: The toggle smoothly animates to 'Day Mode': the background transitions to light blue with fluffy white clouds, the moon element slides out as the sun element (bright yellow, circular, with a subtle glow/shadow) slides in to the left side of the toggle, and the label below updates to display 'Day Mode'.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
